owners.CLAUDE: architecture/acceptance authority -- review, contract design, cross-cutting decisions
owners.OPENCODE: mechanical production engineering, wiring, documentation, deprecation migration

tasks.title: Derive driving-lane COUNT from OSM lanes:*/lanes= tags instead of always emitting 1 per side
tests: new: tests exercising a road with lanes=3/lanes:forward=2/lanes:backward=1 produces the correct lane count and IDs
existing lane-generation test suite must stay green
tasks.expected_metric: On the pinned Ingolstadt OSM source, the fraction of generated roads whose driving-lane count matches their OSM lanes=/lanes:forward+lanes:backward tag (where present) should move from 0% (current, always 1-per-side) to a high majority.
tasks.stop_condition: If a genuinely multi-lane road's downstream junction-connector/lane-link infrastructure cannot represent the added lane count without GAP-003/GAP-011-style breakage, STOP and escalate to CLAUDE rather than partially implementing.
tasks.rollback: Feature-flag the new count-derivation path (default off) until validated against the full regression corpus; existing single-lane-per-side behavior remains the fallback.

tasks.title: Wire the real polygon-intersection SemanticOverlapChecker (quality/semantic_overlap.py) as the live gate; retire the naive co-attachment heuristic

tasks.stop_condition: If switching to the real implementation causes semantic_overlap to newly fail on the current map-of-record at a rate that looks like it's catching many real, unaddressed overlaps (not just a handful), STOP and report the finding to CLAUDE before deciding whether to hard-fail or keep it soft/advisory per the existing map_acceptance.py rationale.

tasks.title: Design and implement a spatial OSM<->XODR correspondence layer with confidence scoring for position-specific metadata (turn:lanes, regulatory signs)
